source_description: Administrative boundaries derived primarily from IGN Admin Express, distributed as generalized GeoJSON.

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)

usage_notes: Join weather department codes to the department GeoJSON property named code.
The department property named region contains the parent region code and can be joined to the region GeoJSON property named code.
Department and region codes must be treated as strings so leading zeroes and Corsican codes are preserved.
These files are pinned to the 2026 release; use the recorded SHA-256 checksums to detect accidental changes.
